_comment: FR-D2 evaluation set. Each query names the chunk that SHOULD be retrieved by
quoting a phrase that appears verbatim in that chunk; the runner resolves the
phrase to a chunk id after ingestion, so the fixture survives chunker changes.
Query text is deliberately a PARAPHRASE and avoids the gold phrase's own
wording wherever possible. The distractors that matter are the sibling chunks
of the same document, not the other documents: every document here has a
single coherent topic, so retrieving the right document is easy and retrieving
the right passage within it is the actual task.
cut  = how many results the pipeline returns (production topK).
pool = the wider candidate window used to measure reranker headroom.

queries.text: How long will green coffee keep in the warehouse before it goes flat and loses sweetness?

gold.phrase: will lose its sweetness in four months

queries.text: What proportion of a roast should happen after the beans crack, for filter?

gold.phrase: development seconds divided by total roast seconds

queries.text: Why does espresso need a longer rest after roasting than brewed coffee?

gold.phrase: espresso wants ten to twenty-one days

queries.text: My hive has already built queen cells. What is the best response now?

gold.phrase: Simply cutting queen cells out is the least effective response

queries.text: How do I quantify the parasite load and when is treatment justified?

gold.phrase: expressed as mites per hundred bees

queries.text: Why would a colony die of hunger when there is still food in the box?

gold.phrase: cannot break to cross an empty frame in deep cold

queries.text: What does making the cable hang deeper cost me elsewhere in the structure?

gold.phrase: at very shallow sags the cable's own stiffness contribution collapses

queries.text: If the 1940 collapse was not the wind matching a natural frequency, what was it?

gold.phrase: torsional flutter

queries.text: How is rusting inside the main cable prevented on a modern span?

gold.phrase: internal relative humidity below roughly forty percent

queries.text: Why does some molten rock pour out quietly while other magma detonates?

queries.text: Which volcanic threat can arrive with no eruption happening at all?

gold.phrase: heavy rain remobilising loose deposits is sufficient

queries.text: Why does day-old bread seem fresh again for a while after warming it?

gold.phrase: two fonts set at eleven point can look wildly different

queries.text: Why do paragraphs from TeX look more evenly spaced than from a browser?

gold.phrase: total-fit algorithm

queries.text: Why was working out east-west position at sea so much harder than north-south?

gold.phrase: fifteen degrees per hour

queries.text: How does a measured star altitude become a line drawn on the chart?

gold.phrase: Comparing computed altitude to observed altitude

queries.text: Why is it harmful to charge a battery quickly when it is cold?

queries.text: Why can't the remaining charge be judged from terminal voltage on LFP cells?
